title: Worst app ever
body: It seems like a cool to do list however when i try to enter the app, I need to log in with a Microsoft account, I dont have one, so i go to creat it and i need a verification code, i go into my gmail app, but the “To do” app resets?So i try a second time and i dont get an email?Then i try again and it says that MY email is already in use, the problem is that the email was brand new. Worst app ever
